meta.name: fastapi-templates
meta.description: Create production-ready FastAPI projects with async patterns, dependency injection, and comprehensive error handling. Use when building new FastAPI applications or setting up backend API projects.

copy.tagline: 搭建带异步与依赖注入的生产级后端 API
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正准备新建一个 FastAPI 后端项目，想拥有一个良好结构的起点。
copy.tagline_en: Build production-ready FastAPI backends with async patterns and dependency injection.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to build a new FastAPI backend and want a well-structured starting point.

howto.what: 它会按固定目录搭建 FastAPI 项目：api、core、models、schemas、services、repositories、main.py，使用 async 路由与数据库操作、Depends 依赖注入、中间件，并产出 pytest 配 httpx 的测试文件。
howto.when: 当你要新建 FastAPI 应用或搭建后端 API 项目时触发，也用于从零开始写 async REST API、微服务等场景。

howto.what_en: It scaffolds a FastAPI project with a fixed layout: api, core, models, schemas, services, repositories, main.py, using async routes and DB calls, Depends injection, middleware, plus pytest/httpx test files.
howto.when_en: Use it when starting a new FastAPI app or setting up a backend API project, including from-scratch async REST APIs and microservices.
